name: Presque Isle State Park
description: Pennsylvania's most visited state park featuring 11 miles of sandy beaches, hiking trails, and stunning Lake Erie views.

name: ExpERIEnce Children's Museum
description: Interactive exhibits designed to inspire creativity and learning in children through hands-on play.

name: Erie Zoo
description: Home to over 400 animals from around the world. Features a train ride, carousel, and seasonal attractions.

name: Erie Maritime Museum & US Brig Niagara
description: Explore Erie's rich maritime history and tour the reconstructed US Brig Niagara, hero of the Battle of Lake Erie.

name: Waldameer Park & Water World
description: Classic amusement park with roller coasters, water slides, and family rides. Free admission, pay-per-ride available.

name: Erie Art Museum
description: Regional art museum featuring American and international art spanning 5,000 years of creative expression.

name: Tom Ridge Environmental Center
description: Free exhibits about Presque Isle's unique ecosystem, observation tower with panoramic views.

name: Peek'n Peak Resort
description: Year-round resort offering skiing, snowboarding, golf, zip lining, and spa services.

name: Splash Lagoon Indoor Water Park
description: Indoor water park featuring slides, wave pools, and attractions for all ages. Perfect for year-round fun!

name: Escape Game Erie
description: Immersive escape room experiences with multiple themed rooms. Great for team building and family fun.

name: Warner Theatre
description: Historic 1931 movie palace now hosting concerts, Broadway shows, and special events.

name: Presque Isle Lighthouse
address: Presque Isle State Park, Erie, PA 16505
description: Historic lighthouse dating to 1873 offering tours and stunning views of Lake Erie.

name: Lake Erie Canopy Tours
description: Thrilling zipline adventure through the forest canopy with views of the lake region.

name: Millcreek Mall
description: Region's largest shopping destination with over 150 stores, restaurants, and entertainment.

name: Bicentennial Tower
description: Observation tower on the bayfront offering 360-degree views of Erie, Presque Isle, and Lake Erie.
